'''Rycher''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who subscribed to "[[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]." Rycher commented on the reputation of [[Stiletto security droid]]s, relaying information that [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were using them modified with [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]].
